# MyMatPay - NHS Maternity Pay Calculator

> Free NHS maternity pay calculator for NHS staff. Calculates Occupational Maternity Pay (OMP), Statutory Maternity Pay (SMP), and total leave income based on NHS Agenda for Change pay bands. Updated for the 2026/27 tax year.

## Key Information

NHS maternity pay for Agenda for Change staff has four phases:
- Weeks 1-8: Full pay (basic salary, offset by SMP)
- Weeks 9-26: Half pay plus SMP (capped at full pay)
- Weeks 27-39: SMP only (flat rate, currently set by HMRC annually)
- Weeks 40-52: Unpaid leave

To qualify for NHS occupational maternity pay, staff need 12 months of continuous NHS service by the 11th week before the expected week of childbirth and must intend to return to work for at least 3 months.

Average Weekly Earnings (AWE) are calculated from the last 2 monthly payslips before the qualifying week. AWE includes base salary, overtime, bank shifts through your Trust, unsocial hours, and on-call payments.

Keeping in Touch (KIT) days: up to 10 days of work allowed during maternity leave without ending leave or losing SMP.

### Maternity Pay by Band

- [Band 2](https://mymatpay.com/nhs-maternity-pay-band-2): Healthcare assistants, support workers - salary £23,500-£25,000
- [Band 3](https://mymatpay.com/nhs-maternity-pay-band-3): Senior HCAs, pharmacy technicians - salary £25,000-£26,500
- [Band 4](https://mymatpay.com/nhs-maternity-pay-band-4): Assistant practitioners, senior admin - salary £26,500-£29,000
- [Band 5](https://mymatpay.com/nhs-maternity-pay-band-5): Staff nurses, midwives, AHPs - salary £31,000-£34,500
- [Band 6](https://mymatpay.com/nhs-maternity-pay-band-6): Senior nurses, specialist practitioners - salary £37,500-£44,000
- [Band 7](https://mymatpay.com/nhs-maternity-pay-band-7): Advanced practitioners, team leads - salary £45,000-£52,000
- [Band 8](https://mymatpay.com/nhs-maternity-pay-band-8): Managers, senior managers - salary £53,000-£72,000

## About

MyMatPay is a free, independent tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the NHS. All calculations are estimates based on NHS Agenda for Change terms and conditions. Users should verify amounts with their Trust's HR department.
